description: Walk germplasm ancestry or descendancy as a deduplicated DAG, with multi-generation traversal, cycle detection, and depth limits. Returns nodes + edges plus traversal stats (depthReached, rootCount, leafCount, cycleCount, deadEndCount).

alias.description: Connection alias registered via brapi_connect. Omit to read the connection registered under alias `default` — i.e. a prior brapi_connect call that did not specify an alias. Calls that used a non-default alias must pass that same alias here.

direction.description: Which direction to walk: ancestors (parents), descendants (progeny), or both.

germplasmDbIds.description: Starting germplasm (1–20 roots). All roots are walked concurrently.

loadLimit.description: Cap on rows returned inline. Omit for the deployment default. Rows beyond the cap land in a dataframe; query with brapi_dataframe_query (SQL) instead of paging row-by-row.

maxDepth.description: Max generations to walk per direction (default 3, cap 10).

name: brapi_walk_pedigree

alias.description: Alias of the registered BrAPI connection the call used.

cycleCount.description: Number of times the walk revisited an already-registered node (cycles broken).

deadEndCount.description: Nodes whose upstream pedigree/progeny lookup failed.

depthReached.description: Deepest BFS level that produced at least one new edge (0 if only roots were walked).

direction.description: The direction the walk expanded (echoed from the input).

edges.description: Deduplicated edge list. `relationship: "parent"` means `from` is a parent of `to`; `relationship: "child"` means `from` is a descendant of `to`.

items.description: One deduplicated pedigree edge between two nodes.

from.description: germplasmDbId of the source of the relationship.

parentType.description: E.g. MALE, FEMALE, SELF, when the upstream response supplies it.

relationship.description: Direction: parent = from is a parent of to; child = from is a descendant of to.

edgesDataframe.description: Canvas dataframe holding the full edge set, present when the walk exceeds loadLimit — edges[] is then a bounded preview. Any edge field that is a reserved SQL word (e.g. `from` → `from_`) is renamed to a SQL-safe identifier; columnLegend maps it back. Query with brapi_dataframe_query (SQL).

columnLegend.description: Maps a sanitized column name back to its original upstream key, for columns renamed to clear the SQL-safe-identifier gate (e.g. `end` → `end_`). Present only when a column was renamed — write SQL against the sanitized (left-hand) names.

columns.description: Full column list of the dataframe.

items.description: Column name from the materialized rows.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the dataframe was created.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which the dataframe metadata will be purged. Re-run the find_* tool to refresh, or copy results out before expiry.

maxRows.description: Cap that was applied at create time, when truncation occurred.

rowCount.description: Number of rows materialized in the dataframe.

tableName.description: Dataframe name. Use with brapi_dataframe_describe (schema + provenance) and brapi_dataframe_query (SQL).

totalCount.description: Total rows reported by the upstream server (may exceed rowCount when truncated).

truncated.description: True when the dataframe hit a row cap before exhausting upstream.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_alias`: No connection has been registered under the requested alias. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

leafCount.description: Nodes that have no outgoing edges in the walked direction — terminal in the DAG.

maxDepth.description: The maximum depth the walk was allowed to reach (echoed from the input).

nodes.description: Deduplicated node list — every germplasm reached by the walk, sorted by depth then DbId.

items.description: One germplasm reached during the walk.

depth.description: Min distance from any root germplasm (0 for roots).

direction.description: Side of the root this node was reached from. `root` = the starting germplasm itself. `ancestor` = reached via /pedigree (a parent of the root or one of its parents). `descendant` = reached via /progeny. `both` = encountered as both an ancestor and a descendant in a bidirectional walk (rare — backcross or selfing chain).

isRoot.description: True when this node is one of the starting germplasm.

nodesDataframe.description: Canvas dataframe holding the full node set, present when the walk exceeds loadLimit — nodes[] is then a bounded preview. Query with brapi_dataframe_query (SQL); JOIN to the edges dataframe on germplasmDbId.

columnLegend.description: Maps a sanitized column name back to its original upstream key, for columns renamed to clear the SQL-safe-identifier gate (e.g. `end` → `end_`). Present only when a column was renamed — write SQL against the sanitized (left-hand) names.

columns.description: Full column list of the dataframe.

items.description: Column name from the materialized rows.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the dataframe was created.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which the dataframe metadata will be purged. Re-run the find_* tool to refresh, or copy results out before expiry.

maxRows.description: Cap that was applied at create time, when truncation occurred.

rowCount.description: Number of rows materialized in the dataframe.

tableName.description: Dataframe name. Use with brapi_dataframe_describe (schema + provenance) and brapi_dataframe_query (SQL).

totalCount.description: Total rows reported by the upstream server (may exceed rowCount when truncated).
